Subject: variant_id=BTK-p.Arg28His gene=BTK accession=Q06187 position=28 reference=R alternate=H

Task: PLAN. Read hypotheses H1 (ligand_binding, currently favoured), H2 (protein_interaction), H3 (stability_folding), evidence E1-E20, gaps G1-G6, and the budget (160 tool calls, 300 compute seconds). Write at least 2 test_candidate records, each with expected learning, feasibility and cost, and which hypothesis it bears on. Write one plan choosing one test, with a reason for rejecting each other candidate. Keep the test within the compute budget. Then write a handoff.

isolation."},{"id":"G4","by":"knowledge_graph","statement":"EVE is not covered for p.Arg28His (state not_covered), so no EVE score is available for this partner."}],"hypotheses":[{"id":"H1","mechanism_class":"ligand_binding","starting_rank":1,"statement":"[Agent-generated hypothesis] Arg28 sits in the BTK PH-domain inositol-phosphate pocket, and His28 membrane.","supports":["E2","E3","E5","E6","E16","E13"],"would_refute":"Ligand-bound experimental structures (for example 1B55 with 4IP) show Arg28 side-chain atoms more than about 4.5 Å from every noise.","latest_verdict":"untested","label":"agent-generated hypothesis"},{"id":"H2","mechanism_class":"protein_interaction","starting_rank":2,"statement":"[Agent-generated hypothesis] His28 disrupts membrane.","supports":["E13","E14","E15","E17","E8"],"would_refute":"Predicted stability change (for example FoldX or Rosetta ddG on the 6TT2 or 1B55 backbone) for R28H is below about 1 kcal/mol, and
